description: This Java class provides functions to map JsonObject and JsonArray instances to MongoDB-compatible BSON documents and arrays, respectively, with configurable key revisions.

classes.name: JsonValueToDbEntityMapper
classes.description: An immutable class that provides functions to map JsonObject and JsonArray instances to BSON documents and arrays for MongoDB storage, with an optional key name reviser function.

methods.name: forJsonObject
methods.description: Creates a function to map JsonObject instances to BsonDocument, using a key name reviser.

methods.name: forJsonArray
methods.description: Creates a function to map JsonArray instances to BsonArray, using a key name reviser.

methods.name: reviseKeyName
methods.description: Applies the key name reviser function to a given JsonKey to produce revised key names.

methods.name: mapJsonObjectToBsonDocument
methods.description: Converts a JsonObject to a BsonDocument suitable for MongoDB storage, using the key reviser.

methods.name: mapJsonArrayToBsonArray
methods.description: Converts a JsonArray to a BsonArray suitable for MongoDB storage.

methods.name: mapJsonValueToJavaObject
methods.description: Maps a JsonValue to a corresponding Java object compatible with MongoDB documents, handling nulls, strings, numbers, objects, arrays, and booleans.

methods.name: mapJsonValueToBsonValue
methods.description: Maps a JsonValue to a BsonValue, converting JSON types to BSON types.

methods.name: mapJsonNumberToJavaNumber
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue representing a number to the appropriate Java Number type.

methods.name: mapJsonNumberToBsonNumber
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue representing a number to the corresponding BsonNumber type.
